summary.text: Wayne Rusk is the Republican candidate for the Montana House of Representatives, District 86, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Archie Thomas in a race with no incumbent. He won the House District 88 seat in 2022 and served in the 2023-2024 session before an unsuccessful 2024 run for the state Senate.

paragraphs.text: Wayne Rusk's career experience includes working as a business owner and as a tradesman working on custom walk-in showers, according to Ballotpedia.
He won the 2022 general election for Montana House of Representatives District 88, defeating Democrat Ko Moua, 70.0 percent to 30.0 percent.
Ballotpedia lists Rusk's committee assignments for 2023-2024 as the Human Services Committee and the House Judiciary Committee.
In 2024 he ran in the Republican primary for Montana State Senate District 44, finishing second behind incumbent Theresa Manzella, 49.4 percent to 42.7 percent.
In 2026 he defeated Kenneth Allen in the House District 86 Republican primary, 61.2 percent to 38.8 percent.
